exports.capture: captureCommand({argv, context, cwd, logPath}) -> CommandLifecycleRecord; requires Crypto | ChildProcessSpawner | FileSystem (all in NodeServices.layer)
exports.exitStatus: shellExitStatus(record) -> exit code, 128+signo for signals, 127 for spawn errors

sourceProbe: Lifecycle JSONL version dx.shell-command.v1 written by captureCommand; shell history zsh EXTENDED_HISTORY and bash HISTTIMEFORMAT/plain lines. Real child processes exercised in test (exit 3, SIGTERM, ENOENT).

checks.cmd: pnpm exec oxlint <5 owned ts files>
pnpm exec oxfmt --check <5 owned ts files>
pnpm --filter @rat-stack/core exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json (filtered to owned paths)
checks.exit: 0 errors in owned files; whole-package exit nonzero from other owners' in-progress files

supportedFields: command.run: argv (redacted, <=32 args), program, exitCode, signal, spawnError, status, startedAt, completedAt, durationMs, cwdRelative, testCommand, contextSource
test.result: outcome passed|failed (derived from exit status), durationMs; failedTests/passedTests null
gaps: Integration (A02/A07) must register shellCommandCollector and add a `dx run -- <argv>` surface that calls captureCommand then exits with shellExitStatus; not in B20 scope.
Test counts are unavailable (only exit status); no reporter parsing.
Shell history import has no exit status, cwd or branch; events carry provisional input context and reconstructed=true.
Runs with a start record but no end record are not emitted; cursor holds before them (a crashed wrapper leaves a permanent gap reported in coverage).
Redaction is heuristic (secret-named flags/env, >=32-char token-like values, URL credentials).
